lines.text: ابن فيلفوس{n:1} الإِسْكَنْدَر زُحَل {ov:رمد كح} مشتري {ov:قسد كح} مِرِّيخ {ov:قكو يح} زُهَرَة {ov:فب يد} والشمس مِثْلها عُطارِد
lines.plain: ابن فيلفوس الإِسْكَنْدَر زُحَل رمد كح مشتري قسد كح مِرِّيخ قكو يح زُهَرَة فب يد والشمس مِثْلها عُطارِد

lines.text: {ov:را كح} وقد أَعَدْنا ذلك وحقَّقْناه وأثْبَتْناه لكلّ واحد منها في اوّل جداول تعديله وهذه الابعاد التي
lines.plain: را كح وقد أَعَدْنا ذلك وحقَّقْناه وأثْبَتْناه لكلّ واحد منها في اوّل جداول تعديله وهذه الابعاد التي

lines.text: رَسَمْناها تتحرَّك ايضًا بحَرَكة فلك الكواكب الثابتة في كلّ سِتّ وسِتّين سنة شمسيّة دَرَجَة واحدة
lines.plain: رَسَمْناها تتحرَّك ايضًا بحَرَكة فلك الكواكب الثابتة في كلّ سِتّ وسِتّين سنة شمسيّة دَرَجَة واحدة

lines.text: وفي كلّ ثمانِ وستّين سنة قمريَّة درجة واحدة ايضًا فخُذْ مِقْدار الحركة في السِّنِين التي بين هذه
lines.plain: وفي كلّ ثمانِ وستّين سنة قمريَّة درجة واحدة ايضًا فخُذْ مِقْدار الحركة في السِّنِين التي بين هذه

lines.text: السنة *المذكورة والسنة التي تُريد فإِن كانت بَعْدَ سنة {ov:اقصا}{n:2} فزده على هذه الأبْعاد وان كانت قَبْلَ{mR:5}{mL:f. 118,r.}
lines.plain: السنة *المذكورة والسنة التي تُريد فإِن كانت بَعْدَ سنة اقصا فزده على هذه الأبْعاد وان كانت قَبْلَ

lines.text: سنة {ov:اقصا} فانقُصه من هذه الابعاد واعمَلْ بها على الرَّسْم.
lines.plain: سنة اقصا فانقُصه من هذه الابعاد واعمَلْ بها على الرَّسْم.

lines.text: قال اذا اردتَّ أن تعرِف رُجُوع احد الكواكب المتحيِّرة واستقامته فأَدْخِل مركز الكوكب المعدَّل
lines.plain: قال اذا اردتَّ أن تعرِف رُجُوع احد الكواكب المتحيِّرة واستقامته فأَدْخِل مركز الكوكب المعدَّل

lines.text: بالجدْول الثالث في سَطْرَيِ العَدَد المتفاضِلَيْن بستّة ستّة اجزاء في جداول رُجوع الكواكب وخُذْ ما
lines.plain: بالجدْول الثالث في سَطْرَيِ العَدَد المتفاضِلَيْن بستّة ستّة اجزاء في جداول رُجوع الكواكب وخُذْ ما

lines.text: بإِزائه في جدْول الكوكب الذي اردتَّ فأَثْبِتْ ما في الجدْول الاوّل من المَقام الاوّل وما في الجدْول
lines.plain: بإِزائه في جدْول الكوكب الذي اردتَّ فأَثْبِتْ ما في الجدْول الاوّل من المَقام الاوّل وما في الجدْول

lines.text: الثاني من المقام الثاني فإِذا عرفتَ المقام الاوّل والثاني فانظُر فإِن كانت حاصّة الكوكب المعدَّلة اقلَّ{mR:15}
lines.plain: الثاني من المقام الثاني فإِذا عرفتَ المقام الاوّل والثاني فانظُر فإِن كانت حاصّة الكوكب المعدَّلة اقلَّ

lines.text: من المقام الثاني واكثر من المقام الاوّل فإِنَّ الكوكب راجع وان زاد على المَقام الثاني ونقَص من الاوّل
lines.plain: من المقام الثاني واكثر من المقام الاوّل فإِنَّ الكوكب راجع وان زاد على المَقام الثاني ونقَص من الاوّل

lines.text: فهو مستقيم السَّيْر. وان كان الكوكب راجعًا واردتَّ أن تعلَم مُذْ كَمْ رجَع فانقُص المقام الاوّل من
lines.plain: فهو مستقيم السَّيْر. وان كان الكوكب راجعًا واردتَّ أن تعلَم مُذْ كَمْ رجَع فانقُص المقام الاوّل من

lines.text: الحاصّة المعدَّلة فما بَقِيَ فاقسِمه على مَسير حاصّة الكوكب ليَوْم وهو زُحَل {ov:{0} نز} مُشْتَرِي {ov:{0} ند} مِرِّيخ
lines.plain: الحاصّة المعدَّلة فما بَقِيَ فاقسِمه على مَسير حاصّة الكوكب ليَوْم وهو زُحَل {0} نز مُشْتَرِي {0} ند مِرِّيخ

lines.text: {ov:{0} كح} زُهَرة {ov:{0} لز}{n:3} عطارد {ov:ج و} فما حصَل فمُذْ تلك الأيّام رجَع. وان اردتَّ أن تعلَم الى كَمْ يومًا يستقيم
lines.plain: {0} كح زُهَرة {0} لز عطارد ج و فما حصَل فمُذْ تلك الأيّام رجَع. وان اردتَّ أن تعلَم الى كَمْ يومًا يستقيم

lines.text: فانقُص تلك الحاصّة المعدَّلة من المقام الثاني فما بَقِيَ فامتَثِلْ به هذا الرَّسْم. وكذلك اذا اردتَّ أن{mR:20}
lines.plain: فانقُص تلك الحاصّة المعدَّلة من المقام الثاني فما بَقِيَ فامتَثِلْ به هذا الرَّسْم. وكذلك اذا اردتَّ أن

lines.text: تعلَم مَتَى يرجِع اذا كان مستقيمًا فانقُص حاصّته المعدَّلة من المقام الاوّل فما بقي فاسلُك به ذلك
lines.plain: تعلَم مَتَى يرجِع اذا كان مستقيمًا فانقُص حاصّته المعدَّلة من المقام الاوّل فما بقي فاسلُك به ذلك

notes.text: 1) Cod. قيلقوس — 2) Cod. اقضى; apud Maghrebinos ض = 90 ut ص apud Orientales. — 3) Cod. {0} لو

observations: L01, L02, L03, L04, L05, L08, L10, L12, L14, L15, L17, L18: long joins (زُحَـل on L01 and L15; جـداول on L02; فخُـذْ on L04; هـذه on L05; معـرفـة, رُجُـوع and المتحـيِّرة on L08; مـا at the end of L10; اقـلَّ at the end of L12; مـن at the end of L14; حاصّـة on L15; هـذا on L17; يرجِـع, فمـا and بـه on L18) are not transcribed; nor the long kāf of لكلّ (L02), بحَرَكة (L03) and الكواكب (L08).

The page ends chapter 45 and begins chapter 46. It has 19 lines. L01 to L05 run the full measure (115 to 541 pt); L06 ends the chapter: it is short (it ends at 305.1 pt) and closed by a full stop. After a space stands the heading of chapter 46 on L07, in the larger type, centred (238.2 to 416.7 pt), and after another space its title on L08, centred as well (222.7 to 432.9 pt) and closed by a full stop. L09 to L18 run the full measure (116 to 540 pt); L09, the first line of the chapter, is set in (it begins at 516.4 pt). L19 is the last word of the paragraph, with its full stop, at the right of the measure (503.0 to 539.2 pt); the line finding left this short line out and it is added by hand. Nallino's line numbers 5, 10, 15 and 20 stand in the right margin beside L05, L08 (the title), L12 and L17: they count the lines of the grid of the page, with the spaces about the heading and the title. The folio number «f. 118,r.» stands in the left margin beside L05, where the asterisk stands before المذكورة. The printed page number at the head of the page stands one line over L01 (118 to 132 pt); it is not a line of the text. Under a rule of 101.5 pt (115.2 to 216.7 pt) stand three notes in one line set in (144 to 540 pt); no full stop closes the line.

Numerals in a smaller type under bars: on L01 the apogees of Saturn {ov:رمد كح} (244;28; bar 21.7 pt), of Jupiter {ov:قسد كح} (164;28; 23.6 pt), of Mars {ov:قكو يح} (126;18; 21.4 pt) and of Venus {ov:فب يد} (82;14; 21.2 pt), each under one bar; on L02 the apogee of Mercury {ov:را كح} (201;28; 19.1 pt); on L05 and on L06 the year {ov:اقصا} (1191; 13.1 and 13.2 pt); on L15 the daily courses of the anomaly of Saturn {ov:{0} نز} (0;57; 15.2 pt) and of Jupiter {ov:{0} ند} (0;54; 15.5 pt); on L16 those of Mars {ov:{0} كح} (0;28; 16.0 pt), of Venus {ov:{0} لز} (0;37; 13.8 pt) and of Mercury {ov:ج و} (3;6; 13.3 pt). The zero is the sign of the codex, a small ring under a stroke; it stands at the right of its numeral.

The note figures: the figure 1 stands on L01 after فيلفوس; the figure 2 on L05 after {ov:اقصا}; the figure 3 on L16 after {ov:{0} لز}. The notes: the codex has قيلقوس; for the year the codex has اقضى, with the remark that among the Maghrebins ض stands for 90 as ص does among the Orientals; for the course of Venus the codex has لو with the zero at its right (0;36). In the note the last letter of اقضى has no dots.

L01: الإِسْكَنْدَر: under the alif the hamza with a kasra under it in one cluster (3.6 x 5.0 pt), a round sukun over the sīn (2.5 x 2.5 pt), a fatha over the kāf (3.6 x 2.2 pt), a round sukun over the dot of the nūn (2.5 x 2.5 pt) and a fatha over the dāl (3.2 x 2.5 pt). زُحَل: a damma over the zāy and a fatha over the ḥā', printed joined in one cluster (6.5 x 7.2 pt), in both copies; on L15 the two signs stand apart (2.2 x 4.3 and 3.6 x 1.8 pt). مشتري: no signs (compare L15). مِرِّيخ: a kasra under the mīm (3.2 x 2.2 pt), a shadda over the rā' (3.2 x 2.5 pt) and a kasra under it (4.0 x 1.8 pt); so too on L15 (3.2 x 2.2, 3.2 x 2.2 and 3.6 x 2.2 pt); the two dots of the yā' are cast in the hollow of the join of the yā' and the khā'. زُهَرَة: a damma over the zāy (2.5 x 5.0 pt), a fatha over the hā' (3.6 x 2.2 pt) and a fatha over the rā' (4.0 x 2.5 pt). مِثْلها: a kasra under the mīm (2.9 x 2.2 pt) and a round sukun over the three dots of the thā', joined to them (3.6 x 6.8 pt together), a ring in the second copy. عُطارِد: a damma over the ʿayn (2.5 x 5.0 pt) and a kasra under the rā' (4.0 x 2.2 pt).

L02: أَعَدْنا: over the alif the hamza with a fatha above it in one cluster (3.6 x 5.0 pt), a fatha over the ʿayn (3.6 x 1.8 pt) and a round sukun over the dāl (2.5 x 2.5 pt). وحقَّقْناه: over the two dots of the first qāf a shadda with a fatha above it (3.6 x 2.5 pt each), and a round sukun over the two dots of the second qāf (2.5 x 2.9 pt). وأثْبَتْناه: the bare hamza over the alif (2.9 x 3.2 pt), a small sukun over the three dots of the thā' (1.4 x 2.2 pt), a fatha over the bā' (3.2 x 2.2 pt) and a round sukun over the two dots of the tā' (2.5 x 2.5 pt), in both copies. لكلّ: a shadda over the last lām (3.2 x 2.5 pt). اوّل: a shadda over the wāw (3.2 x 2.5 pt). الابعاد: no hamza and no signs; so too on L06 (compare L05).

L03: رَسَمْناها: a fatha over the rā' (2.9 x 2.2 pt), a fatha over the sīn (3.6 x 2.2 pt) and a round sukun over the mīm (2.2 x 2.5 pt). تتحرَّك: over the rā' a shadda with a fatha above it (3.2 x 2.2 pt each). ايضًا: the fathatan (3.6 x 3.2 pt); so too on L04 (3.6 x 3.2 pt). بحَرَكة: a fatha over the ḥā' (4.0 x 2.5 pt) and a fatha over the rā' (2.9 x 2.2 pt). كلّ: a shadda (2.9 x 2.5 pt); so too on L04 (3.2 x 1.8 pt). سِتّ: a kasra under the sīn (2.9 x 1.8 pt) and a shadda over the tā' (3.2 x 2.2 pt). وسِتّين: a kasra under the sīn (3.6 x 2.2 pt) and a shadda over the tā' (3.2 x 2.5 pt); no kasra under the tā'. شمسيّة: a shadda over the yā' (3.2 x 2.5 pt), without a fatha. دَرَجَة: a fatha over the dāl, over the rā' and over the jīm (3.2 x 2.2, 3.2 x 1.8 and 3.2 x 2.2 pt); درجة on L04 has no signs.

L04: ثمانِ: one kasra under the nūn, joined to the bowl of the letter in the master scan, in both copies; no second stroke. وستّين: a shadda over the tā' (3.2 x 2.2 pt) and no kasra (compare L03). قمريَّة: over the yā' a shadda with a fatha above it (3.2 x 1.8 and 3.2 x 2.2 pt). فخُذْ: a damma over the khā' (2.2 x 4.7 pt) and a round sukun over the dot of the dhāl (2.2 x 2.5 pt). مِقْدار: a kasra under the mīm (3.2 x 1.8 pt) and a round sukun over the two dots of the qāf (2.5 x 2.5 pt). السِّنِين: a shadda over the sīn (3.2 x 2.2 pt) and a kasra under it (3.2 x 1.8 pt), and a kasra under the nūn (3.2 x 1.8 pt).

L05: تُريد: a damma over the tā' (2.2 x 4.7 pt). فإِن: under the alif the hamza with a kasra under it in one cluster (3.2 x 4.7 pt); so too on L12 (3.2 x 4.3 pt). بَعْدَ: a fatha over the bā' (3.2 x 2.5 pt), a round sukun over the ʿayn (2.2 x 2.2 pt) and a fatha over the dāl (2.9 x 1.8 pt). فزده: no signs. الأبْعاد: the bare hamza over the lām-alif (2.9 x 3.2 pt) and a round sukun over the bā' (2.2 x 2.9 pt), in both copies. قَبْلَ: a fatha over the qāf (3.6 x 2.2 pt), a round sukun over the bā' (2.5 x 2.5 pt) and a fatha over the lām (3.6 x 2.5 pt). وان: no hamza.

L06: فانقُصه: a damma over the qāf (2.5 x 4.7 pt). واعمَلْ: a fatha over the mīm (3.6 x 2.2 pt) and a round sukun over the lām (2.5 x 2.5 pt). الرَّسْم: over the rā' a shadda with a fatha above it (3.2 x 2.2 and 3.2 x 1.8 pt) and a round sukun over the sīn (2.5 x 2.9 pt); so too on L17 (2.9 x 2.2 and 3.2 x 2.2 pt, and 2.5 x 2.5 pt).
L07 (the heading): no signs; والاربعون without a hamza.

L08 (the title): معرفة: no signs. رُجُوع: a damma over the rā' (1.8 x 4.0 pt) and a damma over the jīm (2.2 x 4.7 pt); so too on L09 (2.2 x 4.3 and 2.5 x 5.0 pt); رُجوع on L10 has the damma over the rā' only (2.5 x 4.7 pt). المتحيِّرة: a shadda over the yā' (3.2 x 2.5 pt) and a kasra under its two dots (3.6 x 2.2 pt), which stand on the foot of the join of the yā' and the rā'; so too on L09 (3.2 x 2.5 and 3.6 x 2.2 pt).

L09: اردتَّ: over the tā' a shadda with a fatha above it (3.2 x 2.2 and 3.2 x 1.8 pt); so too on L11 (2.9 x 1.8 and 3.6 x 1.8 pt), in واردتَّ on L14 (3.2 x 2.2 and 3.6 x 1.8 pt), on L16 (3.6 x 2.2 pt each) and on L17 (3.2 x 2.2 and 3.2 x 1.8 pt); no hamza. أن: the bare hamza over the alif (2.9 x 2.9 pt); so too on L14 (2.5 x 2.9 pt), on L16 (2.9 x 2.9 pt) and on L17 (2.9 x 3.2 pt). تعرِف: a kasra under the rā' (3.6 x 2.2 pt). فأَدْخِل: over the alif the hamza with a fatha above it in one cluster (3.6 x 4.7 pt), a round sukun over the dāl (2.5 x 2.5 pt) and a kasra under the khā' (2.5 x 2.2 pt). المعدَّل and المعدَّلة: over the dāl a shadda with a fatha above it (3.6 x 2.5 and 3.6 x 2.2 pt here); so too on L12, L15, L17 and L18.

L10: بالجدْول: a round sukun over the dāl (2.5 x 2.9 pt) and no other sign; so too جدْول and the two الجدْول of L11 (2.5 x 2.5, 2.2 x 2.5 and 2.5 x 2.9 pt). سَطْرَيِ: a fatha over the sīn (4.0 x 2.5 pt), a round sukun over the ṭā' (2.2 x 2.5 pt), a fatha over the rā' (3.6 x 2.5 pt) and a kasra under the yā' (3.6 x 1.4 pt), at the left of its two dots, which stand apart. العَدَد: a fatha over the ʿayn (3.2 x 1.8 pt) and a fatha over the first dāl (3.6 x 2.5 pt). المتفاضِلَيْن: a kasra under the ḍād (2.5 x 1.8 pt), a fatha over the lām (3.2 x 2.2 pt) and a round sukun over the yā' (2.5 x 2.9 pt). بستّة ستّة: a shadda over each tā' (3.2 x 2.5 pt each). اجزاء: the hamza on the line; no hamza over the alif. وخُذْ: a damma over the khā' (2.5 x 4.7 pt) and a round sukun over the dot of the dhāl (2.5 x 2.5 pt).

L11: بإِزائه: under the alif the hamza with a kasra under it in one cluster (3.6 x 4.7 pt), and the hamza over its tooth (2.9 x 3.2 pt). فأَثْبِتْ: over the alif the hamza with a fatha above it in one cluster (3.6 x 4.7 pt), a round sukun over the three dots of the thā' (2.2 x 2.5 pt), a kasra under the bā' (3.6 x 1.4 pt) and a round sukun over the tā' (2.5 x 2.5 pt). الاوّل: a shadda over the wāw (3.2 x 2.5 pt); so too wherever the word stands (L11 twice, L12, L13 twice, L14, L18). المَقام: a fatha over the mīm (4.0 x 1.8 pt); so too the third time on L13 (3.6 x 2.2 pt); المقام the seven other times (L12 twice, L13 twice, L14, L17, L18) has no signs.

L12: فإِذا: under the alif the hamza with a kasra under it in one cluster (3.6 x 4.3 pt). عرفتَ: a fatha over the tā' (4.0 x 1.8 pt) and no other sign. فانظُر: a damma over the ẓā', joined to the head of its stem in the master scan and apart from it in the second copy. حاصّة: a shadda over the ṣād (3.2 x 2.2 pt), without a fatha; so too الحاصّة and حاصّة on L15, الحاصّة on L17 and حاصّته on L18. اقلَّ: over the lām a shadda with a fatha above it (3.2 x 2.2 and 3.6 x 2.2 pt).

L13: فإِنَّ: under the alif the hamza (2.5 x 2.9 pt) with a kasra under it (3.2 x 1.8 pt), and over the nūn a shadda with a fatha above it (3.2 x 2.2 and 3.6 x 1.8 pt). ونقَص: a fatha over the two dots of the qāf (3.6 x 2.2 pt). واكثر, وان and زاد: no signs.

L14: السَّيْر: over the sīn a shadda with a fatha above it in one cluster (3.6 x 4.7 pt) and a round sukun over the yā' (2.5 x 2.9 pt); the full stop follows. راجعًا: the fathatan (3.6 x 2.9 pt). تعلَم: a fatha over the lām (3.6 x 1.8 pt); so too on L16 (3.6 x 2.5 pt) and on L18 (3.2 x 2.2 pt). مُذْ: a damma over the mīm (2.5 x 4.7 pt) and a round sukun over the dot of the dhāl (2.5 x 2.5 pt); so too فمُذْ on L16 (2.2 x 4.7 and 2.2 x 2.2 pt). كَمْ: a fatha high over the kāf (3.2 x 1.8 pt, 14.8 to 16.6 pt over the baseline) and a round sukun over the mīm (2.5 x 2.9 pt); so too on L16 (3.6 x 2.2 and 2.5 x 2.9 pt). رجَع: a fatha over the jīm (3.6 x 2.2 pt); so too on L16 (3.6 x 2.2 pt). فانقُص: a damma over the qāf (2.5 x 4.7 pt); so too on L17 (2.9 x 4.7 pt) and on L18 (2.2 x 4.7 pt).

L15: بَقِيَ: a fatha over the bā' (4.0 x 2.2 pt), a kasra under the qāf (3.6 x 2.2 pt) and a fatha over the yā' (3.2 x 1.8 pt), which has its two dots; so too on L17 (3.6 x 2.2, 3.2 x 1.8 and 3.6 x 2.2 pt); بقي on L18 has no signs. فاقسِمه: a kasra under the sīn (3.2 x 1.8 pt). مَسير: a fatha over the mīm (3.6 x 1.8 pt). ليَوْم: a fatha over the yā' (3.2 x 2.2 pt) and a round sukun over the wāw (2.2 x 2.5 pt). مُشْتَرِي: a damma over the mīm (2.5 x 4.7 pt), a round sukun over the three dots of the shīn (2.5 x 2.9 pt), a fatha over the tā' (3.6 x 2.2 pt) and a kasra under the rā' (3.6 x 2.2 pt); the last letter has its two dots.

L16: زُهَرة: a damma over the zāy and a fatha over the hā', printed joined in one cluster (6.5 x 6.1 pt), in both copies; no fatha over the rā' (compare L01). عطارد: no signs (compare L01). حصَل: a fatha over the ṣād (3.6 x 2.2 pt). الأيّام: the bare hamza over the lām-alif (2.5 x 2.9 pt) and a shadda over the yā' (2.9 x 2.2 pt), without a fatha. يومًا: the fathatan (4.0 x 3.2 pt). الى: no hamza; the last letter has no dots.
L17: فامتَثِلْ: a fatha over the two dots of the tā' (3.2 x 2.2 pt), a kasra under the thā' (3.6 x 2.2 pt) and a round sukun over the lām (2.2 x 2.5 pt).

L18: مَتَى: a fatha over the mīm (3.6 x 2.5 pt) and a fatha over the two dots of the tā' (3.2 x 1.8 pt); the last letter has no dots. يرجِع: a kasra under the jīm (2.9 x 1.8 pt), under its dot; the two dots of the yā' are cast on the foot of the join of the yā' and the rā'. مستقيمًا: the fathatan (4.0 x 3.2 pt). فاسلُك: a damma over the lām (2.5 x 4.0 pt).
L19: المَسْلَك: a fatha over the mīm (3.6 x 1.8 pt), a round sukun over the sīn (2.5 x 2.9 pt) and a fatha over the lām (3.2 x 2.2 pt); the full stop follows.
